title: Metric overrides
description: What writers add to the generated metrics data: reader text, sections, usage guidance, and the facts a scrape could not give for a metric the metrics cluster did not export. doc-tools generate metrics-docs --overrides merges this file into redpanda-metrics-<tag>.json.

_comment.description: A note for other writers. Not copied into the data.

description.description: Text for readers. Replaces the help string from Redpanda, which stays in the data as source_description. A wrong help string is better fixed in the Redpanda source.

unit.description: Unit of the value, when the name does not say it.

labels.description: For a metric the cluster exported: a description and the complete values of labels it has. For a metric the cluster did not export: its labels, read from the source file the gap report names. Giving this list, even an empty one, is what covers that gap.

values.description: The complete set of values the label can take.

use_cases.description: What a reader would use the metric for. Drives the catalog filter.

usage.description: How to use the metric, as AsciiDoc.

availability.description: Deployment -> whether the metric is available there.

requires.description: What a cluster needs before it exports the metric. Replaces the list from the tooling. Use it for a metric the tooling does not know about yet.
